incident-bot: PAGE fired -> SLO: latency.p99 > 2.0s for 5m (service: text-generation-api). PagerDuty incident #PD-12345. Auto-escalation in 6m if not acknowledged.

alice (oncall): Acked. I'm on it. Starting quick triage.

bob (oncall-2): Thx. Any region tagged?

alice (oncall): Grafana: spike concentrated in eu-west. p95 up ~900ms, p99 ~2.4s. Traffic looks normal, no deploys in last 30m.

mike (eng-sre): Noted. KV cache hit rate dropped ~15% in eu-west since 5m ago — could be cache churn. Query: `rate(kvcache.evictions[5m])` shows spike.

sam (prod-ops): Autoscaler didn't add nodes — hitting quota? Checking cloud console.

pagerduty: Reminder: If incident not acknowledged by next escalation, PD will call rotation.

alice (oncall): Temporary mitigations: 1) enable eu-west burst capacity (if allowed), 2) route small % to fallback quantized model (lower latency), 3) warm KV cache by replaying recent prefixes. Thoughts?

bob (oncall-2): Agree. Can we route 10% to fallback variant with rollout policy? That should reduce p99 quickly.

mike (eng-sre): rolling out routing rule now: `redwood route set --service text-gen --region eu-west --weight fallback=10% --note "autopd-mitigation"`

alice (oncall): Doing burst capacity request to infra console. If quota blocks, fallback to soft-shed by rejecting heavy batch requests.

sam (prod-ops): Quota increase request pending, cloud approval ETA ~8m. I'll try to manually spin some dedicated nodes as emergency.

jane (cust-success): Heads-up — a few customers reported slower responses via support #support. No major outage reports, but they're seeing timeouts at ~3s.

alice (oncall): Good to know. I'll update SLAs if this persists.

mike (eng-sre): After routing change p99 for fallback path is ~780ms, overall eu-west p99 dropped to ~1.5s in last 60s.

bob (oncall-2): Nice. Can we keep fallback at 10% and observe 10m? If stable, ramp to 25%.

alice (oncall): Agreed. I'll hold and monitor. Adding snooze on PD for 10m to avoid noisy escalations. `incident-bot: snooze PD-12345 10m by alice`

incident-bot: PD-12345 snoozed by alice for 10 minutes. Next escalation at 1734503380 if not resolved.

mike (eng-sre): Still seeing kvcache eviction rate elevated. Warming job started (replay last 30m popular prefixes).

sam (prod-ops): Dedicated nodes started (2 x g5-like). Should be live in ~90s.

alice (oncall): Thanks. If dedicated nodes up and metrics look stable, we'll remove routing after warmup and scale back fallback.

jane (cust-success): I'll prepare a short note for affected customers: "We're investigating elevated response latencies in eu-west; mitigation in progress."

bob (oncall-2): If things look green in 8m, I'll take postmortem and follow-up action items (autoscaler tuning, kvcache TTL tuning, PD thresholds).

alice (oncall): Handing off to bob at 1734502780 for rotation. I'll sign off once nodes are stable. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

bob (oncall-2): Taking over. Will keep PD snoozed and update on status.

incident-bot: Thread closed by bob (oncall-2) — monitoring continues.
